q2_gaps: An explicit universal over a definite plural carrying a RESTRICTIVE modifier ('all the plates ON THE TABLE'): the range rule sends a kind-naming plural to (Member $x <kind>), which would quantify over plates everywhere and drop the restriction, and nothing states how to carry the modifier into the rule's range — the parse's PartOf-over-a-located-group range is the only faithful option but is prescribed for a different case.

Whether the static locative head covers support / contact prepositions on an entity: LocatedIn is named for and illustrated only with containment ('a village in Calderwick'), while the oblique rule insists on the preposition actually used, leaving 'the plates on the table' between the two.
notes: The group-symmetric rule form — PartOf range, distinctness guard, literal-head conclusion, no Symmetric tag — matches the 'senators are all colleagues' pattern exactly, and the QuantifierPhrase companion correctly names the group kind.
